literal: Duty having known, time having considered, place having known, having deliberated, he who speaks is the foremost.
translation: He who knows his duty, considers the right time, understands the proper place, and speaks after careful deliberation is the foremost envoy.
modern: தன் கடமையை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற காலத்தைக் கருதி, தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து பேசுகின்ற தூதனே சிறந்தவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an outstanding envoy or messenger. The poet outlines four essential steps for delivering a message effectively: knowing one's duty, choosing the right time, finding the appropriate place, and thinking deeply before speaking. An envoy who possesses these qualities and speaks with such preparation is considered the best or foremost in their role. The progression of verbs emphasizes the meticulous preparation required for successful diplomacy.
